blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Inverse rendering for skin typically relies on offline path tracing to estimate physical properties, which fail to map directly to the approximate shaders utilized in interactive applications, such as game engines. We bridge this gap by directly estimating subsurface scattering parameters tailored for real-time rendering pipelines. We introduce a differentiable Screen-Space Subsurface Scattering (SSSS) framework that enables the joint optimization of spatially varying base textures and scattering distances. To account for local variations in skin thickness, we estimate these parameters across distinct facial regions, generating a blended profile map ready for production runtime engines. Our pipeline utilizes a low-cost, single-light, single-view capture setup designed for accessible and practical appearance acquisition. Optimization is driven by a masked loss function targeting regions where subsurface scattering effects are dominant. We validate our approach on a real-world dataset of $45$ individuals across the Monk Skin Tone Scale, ensuring demographic generalization. Furthermore, we complement this evaluation with synthetic data, a multi-light setup validating our single-light assumption, and a tilted-view configuration confirming angular consistency. Results demonstrate that our method effectively recovers scattering parameters from lightweight inputs, yielding realistic skin appearance directly compatible with standard real-time shaders.
blocks.zh: 对皮肤的反向渲染一般依靠离线路径追踪来估计物理属性,这无法直接映射到交互式应用中使用的相近的阴影,如游戏引擎. 我们通过直接估算为实时渲染管道设计的地表下散射参数来弥补这一差距。 我们采用了一个不同的屏幕-空间地表分层(SSSS)框架,使空间不同的基础纹理和相距分散得以共同优化。 为了说明皮肤厚度的局部变化,我们估计了不同面部区域的这些参数,生成一个混合剖面图,准备用于生产运行时引擎。 我们的管道使用低成本的、单光的、单视的捕捉装置,旨在获取无障碍和实用的外观。 优化是由遮掩的损失功能驱动的,其目标区域是地表下散射效应占主导地位的区域。 我们验证了我们在现实世界数据组上采用的方法,该数据集由45美元的个人组成,覆盖了Monk Skin Tone比例表,确保人口概况。 此外,我们用合成数据、多光灯设定验证我们的单光假设和斜视配置来补充这一评价,确认角一致性。 结果显示,我们的方法能够有效地从轻量级输入物中恢复分散的参数,从而产生现实的外表,直接与标准的实时阴影相容.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Accurately simulating human skin remains a significant challenge in computer graphics due to its physical complexity and the high sensitivity of the human visual system to facial appearance. As a layered, anisotropic, and spatially varying medium, skin involves intricate subsurface scattering, fine-scale geometric details, and directionally dependent light transport. To meet the computational constraints of interactive applications, the industry often relies on screen-space approximations rather than full volumetric path tracing. However, the perceptual sensitivity of observers ensures that even subtle rendering inaccuracies appear unnatural. Additionally, the global diversity of skin tones demands methods that generalize across the full spectrum of human pigmentation while maintaining both physical plausibility and real-time performance.
blocks.zh: 精确模拟人类皮肤因其物理复杂性和人类视觉系统对面部外观的高度敏感性,仍然是计算机图形中的重大挑战. 作为一个分层、异位和空间不同的介质,皮肤涉及复杂的地表下散射、细微的几何细节和方向依赖的光传输。 为了满足交互应用程序的计算限制,业界往往依赖于屏幕-空间近似,而不是全量路径跟踪. 然而,观察者的感知敏感性确保了甚至使不准确之处显得不自然。 此外,全球的皮肤色素多样性要求采用各种方法,在保持物理可信性和实时性能的同时,将人类色素的全方位普遍化。

blocks.en: Traditional approaches for capturing skin optical properties often require sophisticated hardware, such as hyperspectral sensors or polarimetric imaging systems [ 23 , 1 , 32 ] . While these methods yield accurate results, they are typically expensive, restricted to controlled laboratory settings, and produce physical parameters (e.g., extinction coefficients) that do not map directly to real-time shaders. Furthermore, they often struggle to scale across the diverse facial expressions and skin tones encountered in real-world scenarios. To address these limitations, we introduce a low-cost, replicable single-view, single-light capture setup. Our compact configuration facilitates the practical acquisition of skin appearance without requiring specialized environments.
blocks.zh: 捕捉皮肤光学特性的传统方法往往需要精密的硬件,如超光谱传感器或极度成像系统[23, 1, 32]. 虽然这些方法产生准确的结果,但它们通常费用昂贵,仅限于受控制的实验室设置,并产生物理参数(如灭绝系数),不直接映射到实时遮荫物. 此外,他们常常在现实世界中遇到的各种面部表情和皮肤色调之间挣扎。 为了解决这些局限性,我们引入了低成本,可复制的单景,单光捕捉设置. 我们的紧凑布局有利于实际获得皮肤外观,而不需要专门的环境.

blocks.en: Instead of estimating offline physical parameters like absorption or extinction coefficients through complex path-tracing intermediaries, we directly optimize the specific parameters used in real-time rendering pipelines. We ground our approach in the Bidirectional Subsurface Scattering Reflectance Distribution Function (BSSRDF), specifically utilizing the Burley Normalized Diffusion profile [ 6 ] , the standard for real-time physically based skin shading. To enable optimization, we implement a differentiable version of the Screen-Space Subsurface Scattering (SSSS) algorithm incorporating this profile. This model provides control via the scattering distance parameter, which governs the distance light travels beneath the surface. Tuning this parameter manually is difficult due to its strong coupling with material appearance and the lack of direct visual references. Our approach automates this process by directly optimizing scattering distance textures from photographic data, enabling efficient and plausible appearance reconstruction.
blocks.zh: 我们没有通过复杂的路径追踪中介来估计吸收或消亡系数等离线物理参数,而是直接优化实时渲染管道中使用的具体参数. 我们的方法以双向地表线下反射分布函数(BSSRDF)为基础,具体使用Burley Normalized Difusion profile [6],即实时物理皮肤阴影的标准。 为了实现优化,我们采用了一个不同版本的屏幕-空间地下散射算法(SSSS),纳入这一配置。 该模型通过散射距离参数提供控制,该参数规范了表面下方的距离光程. 手动修饰这个参数是困难的,因为它与物质外观紧密结合,缺乏直接的视觉参考. 我们的方法通过直接优化从照片数据中散射的距离纹理,使这一进程自动化,从而能够进行有效和可信的外观重建。

blocks.en: Prior work frequently underexplores skin tone diversity, focusing primarily on mid-range tones and resulting in biased models that generalize poorly across lighter or darker skin. To address this limitation and drive representative skin modeling, we anchor our framework in the Monk Skin Tone Scale [ 35 ] (Fig. 2 ). Unlike traditional scales designed primarily for dermatological UV response (e.g., Fitzpatrick [ 14 ] ), the Monk scale provides a perceptually balanced distribution covering the broad spectrum of human skin tones. Our primary goal is to leverage this scale to deliver a lightweight differentiable inverse rendering method that is physically grounded, equitable across diverse populations, and directly compatible with real-time production pipelines.
blocks.zh: 先前的工作经常是勘探不足的皮肤色调多样性,主要侧重于中程色调,并导致偏颇的模型在较浅或较深的皮肤上普遍化差。 为了解决这一限制,推动具有代表性的皮肤模型制作,我们把框架植根于僧侣皮肤通量表[35] (图2). 与主要为皮肤紫外线反应而设计的传统鳞片不同(例如菲茨帕特里克[14]),蒙克鳞片提供了一种可感知的均衡分布,覆盖了人类皮肤色素的广泛范围. 我们的首要目标是利用这一规模来提供一种轻量级不同反向渲染方法,这种方法以身体为基础,在不同的人群中公平,直接与实时生产管道兼容。

blocks.en: Our key contributions are: 1. A lightweight, low-cost, single-light, single-view capture setup explicitly designed for the practical acquisition of facial skin patches across diverse skin tones. 2. A differentiable rendering framework introducing a novel optimization stage to estimate state-of-the-art real-time scattering parameters directly from image data, bypassing complex path-tracing intermediaries. 3. A masked loss formulation that isolates gradients within shadowed regions, where multiple scattering is physically dominant, ensuring accurate and stable optimization of subsurface parameters. 4. A large dataset of calibrated facial skin patches and their estimated optical properties, sampled across the Monk Skin Tone Scale to drive equitable and representative skin modeling.
blocks.zh: 我们的主要贡献是: 1. 一种轻量级,低成本,单光型,单视的捕捉装置,专门设计用于实际获取不同皮肤色调的面部皮肤补丁. 2. 一个不同的渲染框架,引入一个新的优化阶段,直接从图像数据中估算最新实时分散参数,绕过复杂的路径跟踪中介。 3. 一种遮盖式损失配方,将阴影区域内的梯度隔离开来,在阴影区域内,多重分散在物理上占主导地位,确保准确和稳定地优化地下参数。 4. 对蒙克皮肤色素尺度进行采样,以推进公平和有代表性的皮肤模型制作。

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: In this section, we review prior work on skin rendering, categorizing approaches into subsurface scattering approximations, biophysical and material models, physical acquisition methods, and inverse rendering strategies.
blocks.zh: 在本节中,我们回顾以前在皮肤渲染方面的工作,将方法分为浅层散射近似、生物物理和材料模型、物理获取方法和反向渲染策略。

blocks.en: Subsurface Scattering Approximations. Realistic skin rendering requires simulating the complex transport of light through layers of varying opacity. As described by the BSSRDF [ 6 ] , light transport in translucent media falls into three regimes: single scattering (thin materials), multiple scattering (thick materials), and intermediate scattering (turbid media) (Fig. 3 ). While full simulation is computationally expensive, most methods approximate the multiple scattering component to achieve visual plausibility [ 7 ] . The dipole model [ 27 ] remains a foundational approximation for offline rendering, modeling subsurface transport via virtual light source pairs. Subsequent improvements include the multipole method [ 11 ] for multi-layered materials and the directional dipole [ 13 , 15 ] , which introduces anisotropy to better capture detailed surface features. For higher precision, the quantized diffusion model [ 12 ] discretizes the diffusion process, offering finer control over scattering behavior.
blocks.zh: 浅层碎屑 略说. 现实的皮肤渲染需要模拟光通过不同不透明层的复杂运输. 如BSSRDF[6]所述,半透明介质中的轻度运输分为三种:单散(薄材料),多散(薄材料),中间散(扰流介质)(图3)。 虽然完全模拟在计算上是昂贵的,但大多数方法都与多重散射元件相近,以达到视觉可信度[7]. dipole模型 [27] 仍然是离线渲染的基础近似,通过虚拟光源对模拟地下运输. 随后的改进包括多层材料的多极法[11]和方向性二极管[13,15],引入异构法以更好地捕捉详细的表面特征. 为了更精确,量化的传播模型[12]对扩散过程进行盘点,对散射行为提供更精细的控制.

blocks.en: For real-time pipelines, scattering is typically separated into surface and subsurface components. Translucency effects (single scattering) are often approximated using thickness maps generated via inverted-normal ambient occlusion [ 3 ] . For multiple scattering, screen-space techniques are the standard. [ 28 ] and [ 29 ] approximate diffusion by convolving irradiance maps with weighted Gaussian kernels, while [ 8 ] proposed an exponential diffusion profile matching Monte Carlo simulations. Recently, neural approaches such as [ 43 , 42 ] have proposed encoding scattering profiles into lightweight networks, though screen-space convolution remains the industry standard for its predictability and direct integration with standard shading models.
blocks.zh: 对于实时输油管,散射一般被分离成地表和地下部分. 透明效应(单一散射)往往使用通过倒置-正常环境闭塞产生的厚度图进行近似化. [3]. 对于多重散射,屏幕-空间技术是标准. [28]和[29]通过将辐照图与加权高斯内核结合而大致扩散,而[8]则提出了与蒙特卡洛模拟相匹配的指数扩散剖面. 最近,神经学方法,如[43,42],建议将编码散射剖面投射到轻量级网络中,尽管屏幕-空间演化仍然是其可预测性和与标准阴影模型直接结合的行业标准.

blocks.en: Biophysical and Skin Material Models. Human skin exhibits significant spatial heterogeneity. Early measurement-based approaches [ 46 ] demonstrated that fixed scattering parameters fail to capture the variation between regions like the forehead, cheeks, and ears. [ 19 ] introduced layered models to account for epidermal and dermal variations, while [ 41 ] utilized region-based lookup tables, and [ 31 ] extended layered models to simulate cosmetics. Beyond empirical layers, recent biophysical models explicitly simulate physiological processes, such as sun-induced erythema and tanning [ 25 ] , or multi-layer heterogeneous volume transport [ 44 ] .
blocks.zh: 生物物理与皮肤材料模型. 人类皮肤表现出显著的空间异质性. 早期基于测量的方法[46] 表明,固定的散射参数无法捕捉到额头、颊和耳朵等区域之间的差异。 [19] 引入了分层模型,以说明表皮和皮肤的变化,而[41] 使用了基于区域的检索表,[31] 扩展分层模型以模拟化妆品。 除了经验层外,最近的生物物理模型还明确模拟了生理过程,例如太阳引起的红外线和晒制[25],或多层的异质体积迁移[44]。

blocks.en: While volumetric biophysical models offer high biological fidelity, they require computationally demanding Monte Carlo solvers. In contrast, we utilize the Disney 2015 BSSRDF [ 6 ] as our parametric foundation. While the earlier Disney BRDF [ 5 ] —widely referred to in the industry as Burley 12—provided a robust model for surface reflection, it lacked volumetric scattering controls. The 2015 extension, commonly known as Burley 15, introduces a physically derived scattering distance parameter that ensures energy conservation while supporting anisotropic diffusion. This balance of physical plausibility and artist-friendly control makes Burley 15 ideal for our optimization pipeline. Inspired by [ 50 ] , we optimize a scalar scattering distance per facial region under this model and blend them at runtime to achieve anatomical fidelity without sacrificing real-time efficiency.
blocks.zh: 虽然体积生物物理模型具有很高的生物忠心度,但它们需要计算要求的蒙特卡洛解决方案. 相比之下,我们利用迪士尼2015BSSRDF[6]作为我们的参数基础. 虽然早先的迪士尼BRDF[5]——在业界中被广泛称为Burley 12——提供了有力的表面反射模型,但它缺乏体积分散控制。 2015年扩展,俗称Burley 15,引入了物理衍生的散射距离参数,既能保证节能,又能支持异构扩散. 这种物理可信度和艺术家友好的控制的平衡 使得Burley 15 是我们优化管道的理想 在[50]的启发下,我们优化了这个模型下每个面部区域的一个平面散射距离,并在运行时加以混合,以在不牺牲实时效率的情况下实现解剖忠诚.

blocks.en: Skin Appearance Acquisition. High-fidelity skin capture traditionally relies on complex hardware to separate reflectance components. Systems such as Light Stages [ 9 ] , time-multiplexed lighting rigs [ 18 ] , and polarization-based setups [ 33 , 16 ] deliver ground-truth quality. Recent advances include spectral reconstruction methods [ 20 ] and single-shot polarized capture systems [ 38 ] that recover high-quality geometry and appearance. However, these methods require specialized equipment and controlled environments. In contrast, we focus on a lightweight acquisition regime to democratize skin reconstruction. Our differentiable framework optimizes scattering parameters from a single-view, single-light setup, eliminating the need for costly optical components or synchronized lighting arrays. Furthermore, this simplified pipeline remains robust across the full spectrum of human skin tones. This combination of hardware accessibility and tonal generalization provides a scalable solution for realistic digital human creation.
blocks.zh: 皮肤外观收购. 高真性皮肤捕捉传统上依赖于复杂的硬件来分离反射组件. 诸如灯光阶段[9]、多时性照明装置[18]和基于两极分化的装置[33、16]之类的系统提供地面真实质量。 近期的进步包括光谱重建方法[20]和单发极化捕捉系统[38],它们能恢复高质量的几何和外观. 然而,这些方法需要专门的设备和受控制的环境。 相比之下,我们侧重于轻量级收购制度,以使皮肤重建民主化。 我们的异构框架优化了单视,单光装置的散射参数,从而不再需要昂贵的光学组件或同步照明阵列. 此外,这种简化的管道在人类全身皮肤上仍很坚固。 这种硬件可及性和通俗化的结合,为现实的数字人类创造提供了可伸缩的解决方案.

blocks.en: Inverse Rendering for Material Estimation. Material estimation generally falls into learning-based or optimization-based categories. Learning-based methods [ 10 , 53 , 39 ] train neural networks to infer parameters from images, offering fast inference but often lacking generalization to out-of-distribution examples. Optimization-based methods minimize the reconstruction error between observed and rendered images. For example, [ 17 ] optimized spatially varying parameters for fabrics using a differentiable rasterizer. In the domain of skin, [ 1 ] and [ 32 ] have successfully estimated parameters from hyperspectral data. Most closely related to our work is [ 45 ] , which performs inverse rendering for textured translucent appearance. However, while [ 45 ] focuses on general translucent objects, our pipeline is specialized for human skin, incorporating domain-specific constraints (such as the Monk scale and facial region masks) and directly optimizing the screen-space parameters used in game engines. Furthermore, while [ 44 ] estimates biological parameters from a pre-extracted albedo map for offline volume rendering, our framework optimizes directly from raw photographs under directional lighting, decoupling surface reflection (albedo, roughness, specular) and subsurface scattering for real-time screen-space execution.
blocks.zh: 材料估计反向渲染. 材料估计一般属于基于学习或优化的类别。 基于学习的方法[10,53,39] 训练神经网络从图像中推断参数,提供快速的推论,但往往缺乏通俗化到分配外的例子. 基于优化的方法将观测到的图像与渲染的图像之间的重建错误最小化. 例如,[17]利用不同的光栅对织物进行空间差异参数优化. 在皮肤领域,[1]和[32]从超光谱数据中成功估算了参数. 与我们的工作最密切相关的是[45],它为纹理半透明外观进行反向渲染. 然而,虽然[45]侧重于一般的半透明物体,但我们的管道是专用于人皮的,包含特定域的制约(如蒙克尺度和面部区域面具),直接优化了游戏引擎中使用的屏幕-空间参数. 此外,虽然[44] 从预提取的反照率图中估算出用于线下容积渲染的生物参数,但我们的框架直接从定向照明、脱钩表面反射(阿尔贝多、粗糙、光谱)和地下散射等原始照片中优化,用于实时屏幕-空间执行。

blocks.en: 3 Overview and Rendering Model
blocks.zh: 3 概述和渲染模式

blocks.en: This section outlines our proposed pipeline for skin appearance estimation and describes the real-time rendering techniques integrated into our engine to simulate subsurface scattering.
blocks.zh: 本节概述了我们拟议的皮肤外观估计管道,并介绍了我们发动机中用于模拟地下散射的实时渲染技术。

blocks.en: 3.1 Overview
blocks.zh: 3.1 概览

blocks.en: Our approach builds upon the diffusion-based skin model introduced by [ 8 ] , which extends Burley 12 with a subsurface scattering parameter s s . We adopt Burley 15 model for its physical grounding and proven photorealism [ 17 ] . Unlike prior works that fix subsurface parameters to fit surface properties, we explicitly estimate the subsurface scattering terms that dominate skin appearance. We define the scattering distance as d = 1 s d=\frac{1}{s} (assuming a unit mean free path). We replace the standard uniform parameterization with an optimized homogeneous scattering parameter per facial region, which are then blended to create a spatially varying map for local anatomical variations.
blocks.zh: 我们的方法以[8]引入的基于扩散的皮肤模型为基础,该模型将Burley 12扩展为地下分散参数s 。 我们采用了Burley 15 模型 物理地面 和证明的光现实主义 [17]. 与以前固定地表下参数以适应地表特性的作品不同,我们明确估计地表下散射的术语支配着皮肤外观. 我们定义的散射距离是 d = 1 s d=\frac{ 1}{s} (假设单位表示自由路径). 我们用每个面部区域最优化的同质散射参数来取代标准的统一参数化,然后将这些参数混合起来,为局部解剖变异制作一个空间变化图.

blocks.en: We focus on the human face due to its perceptual importance in recognition [ 4 ] and the significant variation in skin thickness that influences light diffusion [ 26 ] . Consequently, our acquisition targets facial skin patches.
blocks.zh: 我们注重人的面貌,因为它在认知中具有认知重要性[4],以及皮肤厚度的显著变化影响光的传播[26]. 因此,我们的收购目标 面部皮肤补丁。

blocks.en: We utilize a single-view, single-light capture setup to extract skin data. To ensure representational diversity, we select subjects spanning the Monk Skin Tone Scale [ 35 ] , capturing the optical variability caused by differing melanin and hemoglobin levels. Our proposed architecture proceeds in two sequential phases: first, we optimize a homogeneous scattering distance d d for each individual skin patch; second, we generate a full facial scattering map by blending these values based on anatomical regions, similar to the profile blending in [ 50 ] . To execute this initial patch-fitting phase, our inverse rendering pipeline directly optimizes a spatially varying Burley 15 texture stack by backpropagating reconstruction errors through a differentiable rasterizer, extending the core optimization framework from [ 17 ] . The complete pipeline is illustrated in Fig. 4 .
blocks.zh: 我们利用一个单视,单光捕捉装置来提取皮肤数据. 为了确保代表性的多样性,我们选择了跨越蒙克皮肤色素尺度[35]的学科,捕捉了不同色素和血红蛋白水平造成的光学变异. 我们提议的建筑分为两个相继阶段:第一,我们优化每个皮肤补丁的同质散射距离d;第二,我们通过根据解剖区域混合这些数值,产生完整的面部散射图,类似于[50]中的剖面混合. 为了执行这个最初的补丁调整阶段,我们的逆向渲染管道直接优化了一个空间变化的Burley 15纹理堆栈,方法是通过一个不同的光栅来背传重建错误,从[17]扩展核心优化框架. 图4说明了整个管道的情况。

blocks.en: This automated approach eliminates manual parameter tuning, driving skin rendering directly from photographic observations. Accordingly, the remainder of the paper details our acquisition protocol (Section 4.1 ), the tensorized scattering architecture (Section 4.2 ), implementation details (Section 5 ), and our experimental results and validation (Sections 6.1 and 6.2 ).

blocks.en: 3.2 Rendering Model
blocks.zh: 3.2 制作模型

blocks.en: We implement a custom real-time rendering engine using WebGL and Babylon.js [ 36 ] . This choice provides a broadly deployable, cross-platform verification environment that runs across a wide range of browsers and devices, including resource-constrained and low-end platforms, allowing us to assess whether the fitted scattering distances produce realistic and physically consistent appearances under practical cross-device rendering constraints. In addition to visualizing the final assets, the engine acts as a synthetic data generator, producing reference images with known ground-truth parameters to validate our optimization procedure.
blocks.zh: 我们使用WebGL和Babylon.js[36]执行自定义实时渲染引擎. 这一选择提供了一个广泛可部署的跨平台核查环境,它跨越广泛的浏览器和设备,包括资源约束和低端平台,使我们能够评估安装的散射距离是否在实际交叉设备的制约下产生现实和物理上一致的外观。 除了可视化最终资产外,引擎还起到合成数据生成器的作用,生成具有已知地面真实参数的参考图像以验证我们的优化程序.

blocks.en: The shading model relies on two primary inputs: a thickness texture and a spatially varying scattering distance texture. In the absence of accurate data textures (measured or artist-painted), local thickness is approximated automatically via inverted-normal SSAO [ 3 ] . The idea is to flip the surface normal, so that the AO hemisphere points into the object instead. Nearby surfaces encountered by those inward-facing samples then provide a rough indication of how close other parts of the object are. When inward-facing polygons are close to one another, they generate more occlusion; this is interpreted as the region being locally thinner.
blocks.zh: 阴影模型依靠两种主要输入:厚度纹理和空间变化的散射距离纹理。 在缺乏准确数据纹理(测量或艺术家涂)的情况下,通过反向-正常SSAO[3]自动对局部厚度进行近似. 其想法是将表面正常翻转,这样AO半球就指向对象. 这些内向样品在接近表面时可粗略地说明物体其他部分的距离有多近。 当内向型多边形相互接近时,它们会产生更多的隐蔽性;这被解释为这个区域在当地变薄.

blocks.en: To encode local scattering behavior, we generate the scattering distance texture via profile blending. Homogeneous scattering values optimized from patches are interpolated using the thickness texture (Fig. 5a ) as a blending weight. This produces a smooth, continuous map (Fig. 5c ) that accounts for thinner skin areas (e.g., ears, nose) without requiring unique profiles per pixel. Optionally, an anatomical region map (Fig. 5b ) can be supplied to assign distinct scattering baselines to specific zones.

blocks.en: 4.1 Acquisition
blocks.zh: 4.1 购置

blocks.en: Estimating physically meaningful texture maps—such as normals, roughness, albedo, and scattering distances—from skin images typically demands complex acquisition systems. Common approaches rely on multi-view setups, polarized lighting, or hyperspectral imaging [ 1 , 32 , 23 ] . While accurate, these systems suffer from limited scalability and high deployment costs. Furthermore, spatially varying estimation is highly sensitive to lighting directionality, local geometry, and microstructural detail [ 19 , 22 , 33 ] , making replication outside controlled laboratories difficult.
blocks.zh: 从皮肤图象中估计实际有意义的纹理图——如正常图象、粗糙图象、反照率图和散射距离图——通常需要复杂的获取系统。 常见的方法依赖于多视图设置,极化照明,或超光谱成像[1,32,23]. 这些系统虽然准确,但可扩展性有限,部署费用高昂。 此外,空间差异估计对照明方向性、局部几何和微结构细节[19、22、33]高度敏感,因此难以在受控制的实验室外复制。

blocks.en: To address these limitations, we propose an acquisition setup that balances simplicity with fidelity and is lightweight in both hardware and operational complexity compared to such laboratory rigs. Rather than requiring custom optical components or electronic synchronization, our system relies entirely on consumer-grade devices, eliminates complex geometric and radiometric calibration protocols, and is easily deployed in standard indoor environments, specifically in a darkened room to eliminate ambient light interference. As shown in Fig. 8a , the setup consists of:
blocks.zh: 为了克服这些限制,我们建议建立一个采购机制,在简洁与忠诚之间保持平衡,与此类实验室钻机相比,硬件和操作复杂性都比较轻。 我们的系统不要求定制光学组件或电子同步,而是完全依靠消费级设备,消除复杂的几何和辐射度校准协议,并且很容易部署在标准的室内环境中,特别是一个变暗的房间里,以消除环境光干扰. 如图8a所示,设置包括:

blocks.en: 1. Subject support. A rigid horizontal platform stabilizes the target surface. Participants place a specific facial region (e.g., cheek or forehead) on a fixed marker to ensure positional repeatability. 2. Illumination source. A projector is used to emit both high-contrast structured line patterns and uniform white light. It is positioned approximately 20 cm from the subject, tilted upwards at 30° relative to the surface plane. This low-angle configuration creates strong directional lighting, maximizing the visibility of subsurface scattering effects while allowing for controlled binary illumination. 3. Imaging system. A high-resolution RGB camera (DSLR) is mounted behind the projector at a distance of approximately 50 cm from the subject. This near-coaxial alignment minimizes geometric distortion and allows the direct capture of reflectance and shading cues under controlled illumination.
blocks.zh: 一、导 言 主体供养. 一个刚性水平平台稳定了目标表面. 参与者将特定的面部区域(如颊部或额部)放置在固定的标记上,以确保位置重复性. 2. 照明源。 投影仪既用于发射高孔结构的线条图案,也用于发射统一的白光. 它的位置离主体约20厘米,相对地表平面向上倾斜30°. 这种低角配置会产生强烈的定向照明,在允许有控制的二进制照明的同时,最大限度地提高地下散射效应的能见度. 3. 成像系统。 一台高分辨率的RGB相机(DSLR)安装在投影仪后面,距离主体约50厘米. 这种近轴对齐将几何扭曲最小化,并允许在受控照明下直接捕捉反射和阴影提示.

blocks.zh: 成像系统. 一台高分辨率的RGB相机(DSLR)安装在投影仪后面,距离主体约50厘米. 这种近轴对齐将几何扭曲最小化,并允许在受控照明下直接捕捉反射和阴影提示.

blocks.en: Although we target a near-coaxial alignment, our pipeline ensures robustness against angular deviations. To maintain a lightweight workflow, we avoid complex projector-camera calibration and structured-light triangulation, relying instead on monocular depth estimation [ 49 ] . We map the network’s normalized output (0 for the near plane, 1 for the far plane) to a physical depth range of 2 cm that bounds the local facial relief, anchored at a measured camera-to-subject distance of 47 cm. All geometric and exposure settings are fixed to maintain consistency across subjects (Section 5 ).
blocks.zh: 尽管我们的目标是近轴对齐,但我们的管道确保了抗角偏移的稳健性。 为了维持一个轻量级的工作流程,我们避免了复杂的投影仪-相机校准和结构化的光线三角化,而是依靠单元深度估计[49]. 我们将网络的正常输出(近平面为0,远平面为1)映射到2厘米的物理深度范围,以47厘米的测量相机对主体距离为锚。 所有几何和接触设置都固定下来,以保持各学科的一致性(第5节)。

blocks.en: Despite its simplicity, this setup successfully captures the subtle shading gradients and scattering cues required for material estimation, avoiding the cost and complexity of multi-camera or hyperspectral systems [ 19 , 1 ] . While specialized hardware offers higher raw fidelity, we demonstrate that optimized differentiable rendering can extract production-quality assets from this minimal input.
blocks.zh: 这种设置尽管简单,但成功地捕捉了材料估计所需的细微的阴影梯度和散射提示,避免了多镜头或超光谱系统的成本和复杂性[19, 1]. 虽然专门的硬件提供了更高的原始忠诚度,但我们表明,优化的异质渲染可以从这种最低限度的输入中提取出生产质量的资产.

blocks.en: To isolate subsurface scattering effects, we generate a light mask by computing the difference between the patterned image ( 9b ) and its inverse ( 9c ). We binarize this difference map using Otsu’s thresholding [ 37 ] , which automatically determines an optimal threshold by maximizing the between-class variance of the intensity distribution. To ensure spatial coherence, we apply morphological dilation followed by opening and closing operations. This process produces two distinct versions of the mask to balance optimization accuracy with visual reconstruction: 1. Loss Mask : An inverted, strictly binary shadow mask ℳ \mathcal{M} (where 1 1 corresponds to shadowed regions) used to focus the optimization loss. Maintaining a hard binary edge here is critical; any blurring of the mask during optimization would alter the edges of the illumination pattern and corrupt the scattering halo estimation. 2. Rendering Mask : A non-inverted light mask ℳ smooth \mathcal{M}_{\text{smooth}} (where 1 1 corresponds to lit regions) smoothed via an 11 × 11 11\times 11 Gaussian filter. This blur emulates projector defocus and prevents hard-edge artifacts in the final render, ensuring a smooth transition where the specular component is added to the masked diffuse component. The resulting preprocessed images and the depth map (Fig. 10 ) serve as the input for our differentiable rasterizer optimization.

blocks.en: 4.2 Tensorized SSSS
blocks.zh: 4.2 标准化SSSS

blocks.en: Porting the screen-space multiple scattering algorithm to a differentiable framework presents a challenge: we must convert per-pixel shader operations into batched tensor computations to ensure efficiency and parallelization. This requires careful handling of texture sampling, coordinate projection, and memory management to maintain differentiability.
blocks.zh: 将屏幕-空间多重散射算法移植到一个不同的框架是一项挑战:我们必须将每个像素遮蔽器的操作转换成批量的测角计算,以确保效率和平行性。 这需要认真处理纹理取样,协调投影,以及内存管理,以保持差异性.

blocks.en: Key aspects of this transformation include: 1. Batch Processing – Instead of iterating per pixel, we process the entire image and all scattering samples simultaneously as high-dimensional tensors. 2. View-Space Reconstruction – To ensure 1:1 consistency with the rendering engine, we reconstruct the 3D position of every pixel using depth and camera intrinsics, rather than relying on 2D screen-space approximations. 3. Differentiable Sampling – We replace discrete texture lookups with differentiable bilinear interpolation, allowing gradients to propagate through the scattering inputs. 4. Memory Optimization – We broadcast operations across dimensions to minimize loop overhead, a critical requirement for performance in tensorized frameworks.
blocks.zh: 这一转变的关键方面包括: 1. 批量处理 - 我们不按每像素进行延时处理,而是将整个图像和所有样品同时作为高维的伸缩器进行处理。 2. 景观空间重建 - 为了保证1:1与渲染引擎的一致性,我们利用深度和相机内在,而不是依赖2D屏幕-空间近似,重建每个像素的3D位置. 3. 可分辨性取样 -- -- 我们用可分辨的双线插值取代离散纹理外观,使梯度能够通过散射输入传播。 4. 内存优化 -- -- 我们跨维度广播业务,以尽量减少循环管理,这是在高压框架中业绩的关键要求。

blocks.en: Batch Processing – Instead of iterating per pixel, we process the entire image and all scattering samples simultaneously as high-dimensional tensors.
blocks.zh: 批量处理 – 我们不以每个像素来重复处理,而是将整个图像和所有样本同时作为高维的伸缩器进行处理。

blocks.en: View-Space Reconstruction – To ensure 1:1 consistency with the rendering engine, we reconstruct the 3D position of every pixel using depth and camera intrinsics, rather than relying on 2D screen-space approximations.
blocks.zh: View-Space Reconstruction – 为了保证1:1与渲染引擎的一致性,我们利用深度和相机的内在特性重建每个像素的3D位置,而不是依赖2D屏幕-空间的近似.

blocks.en: Differentiable Sampling – We replace discrete texture lookups with differentiable bilinear interpolation, allowing gradients to propagate through the scattering inputs.
blocks.zh: 不同的抽样 — — 我们用不同的双线插值来取代离散的纹理外观,让梯度通过散射输入传播。

blocks.en: Memory Optimization – We broadcast operations across dimensions to minimize loop overhead, a critical requirement for performance in tensorized frameworks.
blocks.zh: 内存优化 – 我们跨维度广播业务,以尽量减少循环管理,这是在高压框架中实现性能的关键要求.

Instead, we adopt a fully vectorized approach where the entire image is replicated N N times, creating tensors of shape ( N , H , W , C ) (N,H,W,C) . This allows us to apply the scattering kernel across all pixels and samples simultaneously (Fig. 11 ). The process is as follows:

blocks.en: To capture the input data, we utilize a Sony α \alpha 6100 (ILCE-6100L), a consumer-grade camera that balances affordability with high image quality. Its high-resolution sensor and reliable low-light performance make it an effective instrument for acquiring precise material data, while its accessible price point ensures framework reproducibility. The camera is connected via USB to a PC and remotely controlled using the Sony Imaging Edge desktop application, which provides a live view, full manual parameter control, and automated interval shooting. All images were captured using fixed camera parameters to ensure strict consistency across the dataset. Specifically, we established a resolution of 6020 × 4024 6020\times 4024 pixels, an ISO of 100 100 , an exposure time of 1 / 20 ​ s 1/20\,\text{s} , an aperture of f / 20 f/20 , a white balance of 6000 ​ K 6000\,\text{K} , and a 50 ​ mm 50\,\text{mm} focal length.

Due to the limited geometric cues of this underconstrained setup, we do not optimize surface normals and tangents, relying instead on a fixed Sobel-filtered map derived from a pre-estimated depth map [ 49 ] . To comply with commercial production standards, the parameter 𝐒 T ∈ [ 0 , 1 ] \mathbf{S}_{T}\in[0,1] (encoding up to 1.0 1.0 cm) maps to world-space distance in meters via the metric conversion d = 𝐒 T × 0.01 d=\mathbf{S}_{T}\times 0.01 , where d opt d_{\text{opt}} represents the resulting homogeneous scattering color texture map. Achieving a clean separation of the diffuse albedo 𝐀 T \mathbf{A}_{T} is critical to avoid bias during the scattering optimization; since the Burley diffusion profile (Eq. 1 ) scales directly with 𝐀 \mathbf{A} , any specular energy incorrectly baked into the albedo would artificially shift its chromatic tone. blocks.en: 6 Results
blocks.zh: 6 结果

blocks.en: We evaluate our method qualitatively and quantitatively on both real and synthetic data to demonstrate its reconstruction fidelity, computational efficiency, and robustness across diverse skin tones. Our evaluation is structured into two main parts: (1) an analysis of fitting results on real facial patches across the Monk Skin Tone Scale, evaluating perceptual metrics, runtime benchmarks, and material plausibility (Section 6.1 ); and (2) a comprehensive validation study verifying parameter isolation via synthetic ground truth, assessing our shadow-masked loss through ablation, and benchmarking our single-light setup against a multi-light configuration (Section 6.2 ). Validation of angular consistency via tilted-view experiments is provided in Section 3 of the Supplementary Material.
blocks.zh: 我们用真实和合成数据来定性和定量地评估我们的方法, 以展示其重建的忠实性,计算效率,以及不同皮肤的坚韧性。 我们的评价分为两个主要部分:(1) 分析在Monk Skin Tone 比例尺上真实面部补丁的合适结果,评价知觉度量、运行时间基准和材料合理性(第6.1节);(2) 全面验证研究,通过合成地面真理验证参数隔离,评估我们通过衰竭造成的影子大规模损失,以及参照多光构型来设定我们的单光装置(第6.2节)。 《补充材料》第3节通过倾斜视图实验验证角一致性。

blocks.en: 6.1 Fitting Results
blocks.zh: 6.1 匹配结果

blocks.en: We apply our inverse rendering pipeline to real facial skin patches sampled across the Monk Skin Tone Scale. We evaluate reconstruction quality using the perceptual metric FLIP [ 2 ] , computed over masked regions to isolate the subsurface scattering halo. Fig. 12 shows representative examples from light, medium, and dark skin tones. The reconstructions closely match the input photographs, particularly in the shadowed transition regions where scattering dominates.

blocks.en: We visualize the optimized Burley 15 material stack alongside the auxiliary residual specular map in Fig. 13 . The estimated textures are spatially smooth and consistent across the dataset. Utilizing a monocular depth-based normal prior, rather than relying on photometric cues, regularizes the single-view optimization, mitigating parameter instability across complex structures like the ear. While this depth prior acts as a low-frequency approximation that lacks sharp pore-level details—yielding smoother roughness maps—and screen-space shading partially bakes self-shadows into albedo across steep relief (e.g., ear folds), our multi-light validation confirms the scattering parameter d d converges consistently. This demonstrates that subsurface optimization remains effectively decoupled from localized shadowing and micro-geometric inaccuracies.
blocks.zh: 我们在图13中将优化的 Burley 15 材料堆栈 与辅助残片图一起呈现出来 估计的纹理在空间上是光滑的,在数据集之间是一致的。 利用单视深度的正常前置,而不是依赖光度测量提示,规范单视优化,减轻像耳朵这样的复杂结构的参数不稳定性. 虽然这种深度以前是一种低频近似,缺乏尖锐的孔径级细节——产生更平滑的粗糙度图——和屏幕空间遮蔽部分地将自影烤成反照率,跨越陡峭的宽度(如耳折),但我们的多光验证证实了散射参数dd的一致。 这表明,地下优化仍然有效地与局部阴影和微几何不准确现象脱钩。

blocks.en: Crucially, the estimated scattering distance maps exhibit intuitive trends across the skin tone spectrum. As illustrated in Fig. 14 , darker skin tones correspond to shorter scattering distances, consistent with the reduced subsurface light transport in melanin-rich tissue. These findings demonstrate the physical plausibility of our RGB-based optimizations without the need for hyperspectral data. Furthermore, our masking strategy effectively focuses supervision on shadowed regions, improving multiple scattering estimates in darker skin where the effect is subtle but directionally dependent.
blocks.zh: 关键的是,估计的散射距离图显示了整个皮肤色调谱的直观趋势。 如图14所示,较深的皮肤色素与较短的散射距离相对应,这与富含黑色素组织的浅层光迁移减少相一致。 这些调查结果表明,我们基于RGB的优化在物理上是可信的,不需要超光谱数据。 此外,我们的遮掩战略有效地把监督重点放在阴影地区,改进了在较暗的皮肤中多种分散的估计,在这种皮肤中,影响是微妙的,而是方向上的依赖。

Curves show channel-wise reflectance decay (RGB) alongside estimated albedo. The trend of decreasing scattering distance with darker skin tones confirms the physical plausibility of our optimization.

blocks.en: 6.2 Validation
blocks.zh: 6.2 审定

blocks.en: We validate our pipeline using synthetic skin patches rendered under known Burley parameters [ 6 ] with an identical sampling budget ( N = 128 N=128 ) to ensure numerical consistency during inverse optimization. In the first experiment, we fix all surface attributes (albedo, normals, roughness, IOR) and optimize only the scattering distance. This isolates the scattering estimation stage. As shown in Fig. 15 , the estimated scattering maps ( d o ​ p ​ t d_{opt} ) closely match the reference ground truth ( d r ​ e ​ f d_{ref} ), and the rendered reconstructions are visually indistinguishable from the inputs.
blocks.zh: 我们利用在已知的Burley参数[6]下提供的合成皮肤补丁验证我们的管道,其取样预算相同(N=128 N=128),以确保逆向优化时的数字一致性。 在第一个实验中,我们固定所有表面属性(albedo,正常,粗糙,IOR),并优化只有散射距离. 这隔离了分散估计阶段。 如图15所示,估计的散射图(d o p t d_{opt})与参考的地面真象(d r e f_{ref})密切吻合,所提供的重建与投入在视觉上是无法区分的。

blocks.en: In the second experiment, we fix the scattering distance and vary the albedo across the ten synthetic tones of the Monk Scale to test robustness to pigmentation changes. While Figure 16 shows a representative subset, Section 4 of the Supplementary Material details the full 10-tone evaluation alongside the real-world dataset distribution ( N = 45 N=45 ) cross-referenced against participant self-assessments.

blocks.zh: 图16 跨蒙疆规模合成验证. 我们修复散射距离,并改变反照率(Monk 01, 05, 10)。 低知觉误差(FLIP)和一致的参数回收证实了反照率的强性。

blocks.en: Our pipeline employs a residual specular map to absorb high-frequency highlights, mitigating their leakage into the albedo map. To validate this strategy, we optimize a synthetic scene where the ground-truth decomposition between albedo and specular reflection is known. Fig. 17 compares the optimized residual map against the ground-truth specular contribution. The close resemblance confirms that our robust mean albedo computation effectively shields the diffuse component, allowing the residual map to accurately capture the specular response. Furthermore, this separation minimizes the risk of unmodeled specular energy corrupting other surface attributes, directly validating why our framework achieves highly stable and smooth roughness maps with suppressed artifact bleeding.
blocks.zh: 我们的输油管使用一个残余的光谱图来吸收高频亮度,减少它们渗入反照率图. 为了验证这个策略,我们优化了一种合成场景,在这种场景中,反照率和光谱反射之间的地面-真实分解是已知的。 图17 将优化后的剩余地图与地面真实分光图相比。 近似性证实,我们强有力的平均反照率计算有效地保护了扩散部分,使剩余图能够准确捕捉光谱反应。 此外,这种分离将未建模的光谱能量腐蚀其他表面属性的风险降低到最低程度,直接验证我们的框架为何用被抑制的文物出血实现高度稳定和平滑的粗糙度图.

blocks.en: Figure 17: Validation of specular isolation. We compare the ground-truth specular contribution (Reference) against the optimized residual specular map (Render). The low error demonstrates that our albedo initialization enables the optimizer to effectively capture and absorb specular reflections within the residual map, mitigating their contamination of the base material parameters.
blocks.zh: 图17:光谱隔离鉴定. 我们比较了地面-真实的光谱贡献(参考)与优化的剩余光谱图(Render). 低误差表明,我们的反照率初始化使优化器能够有效捕获和吸收剩余地图内的光谱反射,减轻其对基质物质参数的污染。

blocks.en: To isolate the contribution of our shadow-masked loss during Stage 3 ( ℳ opt = ℳ \mathcal{M}_{\text{opt}}=\mathcal{M} ), we performed an ablation study comparing this formulation against unmasked full-image loss supervision ( ℳ opt = 𝟏 \mathcal{M}_{\text{opt}}=\mathbf{1} ) under identical rendering conditions (Figure 18 ). In the unmasked setting, incident irradiance across directly illuminated stripes is orders of magnitude higher than within shadowed regions. Consequently, backpropagation gradients are dominated by surface reflectance components (diffuse albedo and specular highlights), introducing severe gradient competition against the subtle, low-frequency subsurface diffusion halo. The optimizer attempts to compensate for subtle direct-light discrepancies by skewing the scattering distance parameter d d .
blocks.zh: 为了隔离第3阶段(Mop = M\ mathcal{M}_{\text{opt}}=\mathcal{M})中我们影子大规模损失的贡献,我们在相同的渲染条件(图18)下,进行了一种将这种配方与未蒙面的全图像损失监督(Mop = 1\mathcal{M}_{\text{opt}}=\mathbf{1})进行比较的减速研究. 在无遮挡的环境下,直接照亮条纹的事件辐照程度比阴影地区高。 因此,反向传播梯度以表面反射部分(反照率和光谱突出)为主,对低频低频的地下扩散光环引入了严重的梯度竞争。 优化器试图通过扭曲散射距离参数dd来弥补微妙的直光差异。

blocks.en: Interestingly, while the relative spectral proportionality ( d r > d g > d b d_{r}>d_{g}>d_{b} ) is naturally preserved due to the lower absorption of melanin and hemoglobin at longer wavelengths, the unmasked optimization yields an artificially saturated and magnitude-shifted d d . This magnitude shift truncates the diffusion tail along transition boundaries. In contrast, restricting the loss domain strictly to the binary shadow mask ℳ \mathcal{M} decouples parameter estimation from direct surface illumination, forcing the objective function to evaluate the pure radial decay of multiple scattering. This targeted supervision eliminates parameter overcompensation, ensuring that the estimated parameter d d yields a reconstruction closer to the reference capture, decreasing the perceptual FLIP error from 0.11 0.11 to 0.06 0.06 ( 45 % 45\% reduction) in shadowed transition regions, and from 0.15 0.15 to 0.10 0.10 across the full patch.

Supervising unlit regions isolates subsurface halos, preventing direct light from skewing the scattering distance d opt d_{\text{opt}} (insets) and reducing FLIP error across both the full patch and masked shadow regions.

blocks.en: To evaluate robustness under real-world conditions, we compare our single-light results against a multi-light setup (three synchronized projectors). This configuration allows us to introduce an additional preliminary optimization stage to the pipeline. In this new Stage 1, we leverage the multi-light observations to specifically optimize and refine the initial Sobel-filtered normal map, improving geometric consistency before proceeding with the standard material estimation steps (now shifted to Stages 2, 3, and 4).
blocks.zh: 为了评价在现实世界条件下的稳健性,我们将我们的单光结果与多光线设置(三个同步投影仪)进行比较. 这种配置使我们能够在管道中引入额外的初步优化阶段. 在这个新的第一阶段,我们利用多光度观测,专门优化和完善最初的Sobel过滤的普通地图,提高几何一致性,然后开始标准材料估计步骤(现在转向第2、3和4阶段)。

blocks.en: We compare the scattering distance maps estimated from our standard single-light pipeline against those produced using this augmented four-stage multi-light configuration. Despite the improved geometric detail provided by the refined normals, the single-light method yields scattering distances that are visually and numerically consistent (mean ℒ 1 \mathcal{L}_{1} difference < 2 % <2\% ). As shown in Fig. 19 , discrepancies are minimal and confined to occluded regions.
blocks.zh: 我们比较了从我们标准单光管道中估计的散射距离图与使用这种增强的四级多光配置而制作的散射距离图。 尽管精细的常态提供了更好的几何细节,但单光法产生的散射距离在视觉和数字上是一致的(平均L 1\mathcal{L}_{1} 差值 < 2% < 2\% )。 如图19所示,差异很小,仅限于被占用地区。

blocks.en: Fig. 20 illustrates the material maps derived from the multi-light setup. By leveraging additional lighting data, this configuration improves the estimation of surface properties—particularly roughness—and better handles challenging facial regions such as the nose or ears. Although the setup is still constrained by the limited angular coverage of the three projectors, the multi-light approach provides more detailed material stacks. However, the recovered scattering distance parameters and the resulting rendering reconstructions are nearly identical to those produced by the single-view baseline. These results confirm that for the specific task of estimating subsurface scattering, our single-light, single-view approach remains both sufficient and robust.

blocks.en: 7 Conclusions
blocks.zh: 7 结论

blocks.en: We presented a lightweight differentiable inverse rendering pipeline for estimating subsurface scattering parameters of human skin directly from single-view, single-light captures. By optimizing the same parameters used in standard real-time shading models, our method establishes a direct bridge between physical acquisition and production-ready rendering pipelines, eliminating the need for complex optical setups or intermediate physical volumetric parameter conversion.
blocks.zh: 我们提出了一个轻量级不同反向渲染管道,用于直接从单视,单光捕捉来估计人类皮肤的地下散射参数。 通过优化标准实时阴影模型中使用的相同参数,我们的方法在物理获取和生产准备的渲染管道之间建立了直接桥梁,消除了复杂光学设置或中间物理量参数转换的需要.

blocks.en: Our experiments demonstrate that physically plausible scattering distances can be estimated from minimal input data. The recovered parameters produce a realistic skin appearance across a wide range of skin tones, exhibiting consistent numerical convergence in synthetic benchmarks and high perceptual reconstruction fidelity on real-world captures. The proposed shadow-aware loss formulation improves robustness in regions dominated by multiple scattering, enabling reliable estimation even under challenging pigmentation conditions. Furthermore, our dataset includes a diverse collection of calibrated skin samples aligned with the Monk Skin Tone Scale, supporting inclusive and scalable digital human modeling.
blocks.zh: 我们的实验表明,从最小的输入数据可以估计物理上可行的散射距离。 回收的参数在各种皮肤吨位上产生了现实的皮肤外观,在合成基准上呈现出一致的数值趋同,在现实世界捕捉上呈现出高度的感官重建忠心. 拟议的影子意识损失配方提高了以多种散射为主的区域的稳健性,即使在富有挑战性的色素条件下也能够进行可靠的估计。 此外,我们的数据集还收集了与Monk Skin Tone比例尺一致的多种校准皮肤样本,支持包容性和可扩展的数字人类模型。

blocks.en: A key result of this work is that production-ready subsurface scattering parameters can be estimated from an accessible capture setup without relying on laboratory-grade acquisition systems. Rather than requiring specialized hardware or complex measurement procedures, our approach makes the problem tractable through differentiable optimization, physically motivated parameterization, and carefully designed supervision. This substantially lowers the barrier to high-quality skin digitization while preserving compatibility with real-time rendering workflows.
blocks.zh: 这项工作的一个关键成果是,可以不依赖实验室级的获取系统,从无障碍捕获装置中估算生产准备的地下散射参数。 我们的方法不是需要专门的硬件或复杂的测量程序,而是通过不同的优化、物理动机参数化和精心设计的监督,使问题可以被采用。 这大大降低了高质量皮肤数字化的障碍,同时保持与实时渲染工作流程的兼容性。

blocks.en: The method relies on a locally homogeneous scattering assumption, and monocular depth priors. These assumptions allow the inverse problem to remain practical while still producing parameters that are physically plausible and visually effective. In the single-light setting, the ambiguity between albedo and scattering is addressed through a multi-stage optimization strategy that stabilizes parameter recovery. In thin or highly translucent structures, such as nose cartilage or the ear helix, omitting explicit single-scattering optimization may lead to slightly larger estimated scattering distances, as the model explains missing translucency through the available parameters. Our regional blending scheme constrains these estimates within realistic ranges and preserves a consistent appearance across facial regions. Similarly, omitting non-local visibility handling causes residual self-shadows to be partially absorbed into the albedo in areas of steep relief.
blocks.zh: 这种方法依赖于当地单一的散射假设和单倍深度的前身。 这些假设使得反向问题仍然切实可行,同时仍然产生物理上可信和视觉上有效的参数。 在单光设定中,反照率与散射之间的模糊性通过稳定参数回收的多阶段优化策略来解决. 在薄薄或高度半透明的结构中,如鼻软骨或耳螺旋,省略明显的单裂优化可能导致估计的散射距离略大,因为模型通过现有参数解释缺失的半透明性. 我们的区域混合计划将这些估计限制在现实范围内,并保持面部各区域的一贯外观。 同样,不处理非局部可见度会导致残余的自影部分吸收到陡峭的反照率地区。

blocks.en: Future work can build on this foundation by jointly recovering additional scattering components, incorporating stronger learned priors, integrating differentiable visibility testing to resolve self-shadowing, and extending the capture protocol to less constrained environments. More flexible acquisition strategies could further improve the fidelity of reconstruction while maintaining the accessibility of the proposed setup.
blocks.zh: 今后的工作可以在此基础上再接再厉,共同回收更多的分散组件,纳入更强的以往经验,整合不同的可见度测试,以解决自我影射问题,并将捕捉协议扩展至限制较少的环境。 更灵活的采购战略可以进一步提高重建的诚信度,同时保持拟议结构的无障碍性。

blocks.en: By combining accessible acquisition, differentiable optimization, physically grounded constraints, and validation across diverse skin tones, our method provides a scalable path toward realistic and inclusive digital human creation for real-time applications.
blocks.zh: 我们的方法结合了无障碍的获取、不同的优化、基于物理的制约以及各种皮肤色调的验证,为现实和包容性的数字人类创造提供了一条可扩展的实时应用之路。

blocks.en: Figure 1: Map progression across optimization stages. Green and red denote active and frozen maps, respectively. Stage 1 fits global reflection, capturing unmodeled specular highlights into the residual map while shielding initialized albedo. Stage 2 unfreezes albedo to absorb diffuse spatial details, enabling the ℒ 2 \mathcal{L}_{2} prior to smooth roughness while preserving the specular residual. Stage 3 optimizes scattering distance over shadow-masked regions (Input) with surface maps frozen.

blocks.en: To complement the optimization methodology described in the main manuscript, Figure 1 illustrates the step-by-step visual progression of active and frozen material maps across our three optimization stages.
blocks.zh: 为了补充主稿中所述的优化方法,图1说明了我们三个优化阶段的活性与冷冻材料地图的逐步视觉进展。

blocks.en: During Stage 1, freezing the albedo 𝐀 T \mathbf{A}_{T} forces the reconstruction loss to temporarily drive the active roughness map ( 𝝆 T \boldsymbol{\rho}_{T} ) to fit low-frequency diffuse shading gradients. In Stage 2, unfreezing 𝐀 T \mathbf{A}_{T} provides the direct path to resolve these diffuse reconstruction errors. As the albedo rapidly absorbs the spatial shading details, the reconstruction gradient on other maps vanishes. Consequently, the ℒ 2 \mathcal{L}_{2} roughness prior smoothly regularizes 𝝆 T \boldsymbol{\rho}_{T} while leaving the residual specular map virtually unperturbed, matching its role as a buffer designed for unmodeled specular highlights rather than diffuse light transport.
blocks.zh: 在第一阶段, 冻结反照率 A T\ mathbf{A}_{T} 迫使重建损失暂时驱动主动粗糙度图( $ T\ boldsymbol\rho}_{T}) 以适应低频扩散阴影梯度 。 在阶段2中,解冻A T\ mathbf{A}_{T}提供了解决这些分散重建错误的直接路径. 随着反照率迅速吸收空间阴影细节,其他地图上的重建梯度消失了. 因此,L 2\ mathcal{L}_{2} 粗糙度在将 $ T\boldsymbol\rho}_{T} 顺利地规范化的同时, 让剩余光谱图几乎没有扰动, 匹配它作为缓冲器的作用, 设计用于未建模光谱突出而非扩散光传输 。

blocks.en: To verify that our frontal-view optimization yields physically grounded parameters rather than view-dependent overfitted solutions, we perform tilted-view cross-validation on both synthetic and real data. For synthetic targets, we optimize parameters independently from frontal and novel tilted views, verifying that the estimated scattering distance ( d opt d_{\text{opt}} ) consistently matches the ground truth ( d ref d_{\text{ref}} ). For real targets, we evaluate acquisitions of identical skin regions under varying camera angles. As shown in Fig. 2 , estimated scattering distances remain invariant across orientations, yielding minimal reconstruction error.
blocks.zh: 为了验证我们的前视优化能产生物理上的基础参数,而不是依赖视图的过度适应解决方案,我们在合成和真实数据上都进行倾斜的视角交叉验证. 对于合成目标,我们从正面和新颖的倾斜视图中独立优化参数,核实估计的散射距离(docat d_{\text{opt}}})与地面真理一致(d ref d_{\text{ref}} ). 对于真正的目标,我们以不同的相机角度来评估同一皮肤区域的获取情况。 如图2所示,估计的散射距离在方位上仍然变化不定,造成最小的重建错误。

blocks.en: Our pipeline avoids 2D projection approximations by executing scattering calculations directly in 3D view space using the estimated geometric depth. This integration ensures that the Screen-Space Subsurface Scattering (SSSS) algorithm naturally accounts for surface curvature and perspective foreshortening. By computing physical distances rather than simple 2D pixel offsets, the model recovers orientation-invariant scattering profiles.
blocks.zh: 我们的管道通过使用估计几何深度在3D视图空间直接执行散射计算来避免2D投影近似. 这种整合确保了屏幕-空间地表下散射算法自然地考虑到表面曲率和前景的缩短。 通过计算物理距离而不是简单的2D像素抵消,模型可以恢复定向-不变量散射剖面.

blocks.en: Discrepancies between computed tones and self-assessments in the matrix reveal inherent human perception biases and visual ambiguities when isolating pure albedo from overall lightness under casual observation. Consequently, standardized computational environments and objective physical optimization pipelines are essential for consistent, illumination-invariant tone classification.
blocks.zh: 矩阵中计算出的吨位和自我评估之间的差异表明,在将纯反照率与整体轻度隔离在随机观察下时,人类固有的认知偏差和视觉模糊不清。 此外,最初的Monk比例尺具有内在的感知性,参考颜色在未校准的照明条件下定义. 因此,标准化的计算环境和客观的物理优化管道对于一致的、发光-变化无常的语气分类至关重要。

blocks.en: Initializing the albedo from a flat-lit, diffuse-only baseline is critical for downstream parameter decoupling. Arbitrary or global-mean initialization risk optimization collapse into local minima due to facial features, hair, or micro-shadow contamination. If specular highlights contaminate the initial albedo estimate, the optimization struggles to isolate independent light transport components. Securing a clean, purely diffuse baseline guarantees that high-frequency specular details are absorbed into the residual specular map rather than getting baked into the estimated albedo or roughness maps.
blocks.zh: 将反照率从平升的、只扩散的基线初始化,对于下游参数脱钩至关重要。 由于面部特征,毛发,或微阴影污染,任意或全球性的初始化风险优化崩溃为局部微型马. 如果光谱突出污染了初始反照率估计,优化则会挣扎孤立独立的光传输组件. 确保一个清洁的、纯粹分散的基线保证,高频光谱细节被吸收到剩余光谱图中,而不是被烤成估计反照率或粗糙度图。

blocks.en: We perform our initialization strategy in two stages (Algorithm 1 ):
blocks.zh: 我们分两个阶段执行初始化战略(算法1):

blocks.en: 1. Adaptive Skin Masking: The input is converted to CIE L ∗ ​ a ∗ ​ b ∗ L^{*}a^{*}b^{*} space. Chromatic channels ( a ∗ , b ∗ a^{*},b^{*} ) are clustered via k k -means ( k = 2 k=2 ) after filtering low-luminance background pixels ( L ∗ ≤ 20 L^{*}\leq 20 ). blocks.en: While forward rendering executes via the GPU fragment shader, inverse optimization requires an auto-differentiable SSSS model to backpropagate loss gradients. We translate the screen-space diffusion pass into vectorized PyTorch operations by broadcasting inputs across the N N importance sample coordinates into a unified high-dimensional tensor. This architecture enables simultaneous 3D view-space reconstruction, projection, and differentiable bilinear texture lookups, removing sequential per-pixel execution loops. The tensorized execution logic is formalized in Algorithm 3 , where tuples within the inline comments denote multi-dimensional tensor shapes, and equation references correspond to the formulations established in the main text.
